meta.title: Address zip/postal_code validation + top countries dropdown

chat.content: What did we do so far?
Phone/zipcode field bhi check krnhi he

Phone aur zipcode validation verified — sab sahi kaam kar raha hai. Invalid phone (abc) → block + toast. Invalid zip (AB) → block + toast. Valid phone/zip → pass. Country/State/City cascading, empty required block, serialized data sab check hua. Headless test 23/23 PASS.
zipcode abhi bhi validate nhi he

Root cause mila: admin customer/user forms aur profile-edit me zip field ka name `postal_code` hai, par JS validation sirf `[name="zip_code"]` check karta tha → postal_code field poori tarah skip ho jaati thi. Backend me bhi postal_code pe regex nahi tha.

Fixes:
- address-fields.blade.php: zip check ab selector `[name="zip_code"], [name="postal_code"]` use karta hai; @error bhi actual field name ke saath.
- UserController (storeCustomer + update): postal_code pe regex `/^[A-Za-z0-9\-\s]{3,20}$/`.
- AdminController (updateProfile): wahi regex.

Verified (real pages, headless): profile-edit (postal_code) 8/8 PASS, addresses (zip_code) 6/6 PASS, backend AB fail / 10001 pass.
country field me top countries show ho skti he dropdown me

Country dropdown me top countries sabse upar pin kiye. address-fields.blade.php me `$topCountries` array (United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, Germany, France, India, United Arab Emirates) placeholder ke baad render hota hai, alphabetical list se skip (duplicate nahi). Searchable dropdown select.options iterate karta hai isliye order auto carry hota hai.

Verified (headless, live page 4/4 PASS): dropdown ke pehle 8 items pinned top countries in order, Afghanistan se alphabetical remainder shuru; edit forms me saved country pehle, no duplicate.

TASKS.md updated with #161 (Zip/Phone validation — postal_code forms skipped) and #162 (Country dropdown — top countries pinned at top). Chat log saved to chat-logs/opencode_2026-08-14_*.md + .json via the project's chat-saver.php save_chat() helper.
